verdict.rationale: Lambda's pricing page offers reserved capacity "at our lowest prices," but only by contacting sales. The self-serve on-demand and 1-Click Cluster offerings are explicitly sold with "no long-term commitments," and Private Cloud single-tenant clusters are the other sustained-capacity option. missing for 10: documented reservation terms (commitment lengths, discount levels), self-serve or API-driven reservation purchase, committed-use billing documentation, independent corroboration of reserved pricing.
